issue_context.title: sleep with `/*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */` hint do not return expected error
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

Run `select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ sleep(1)`.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```
mysql> select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ sleep(1);
ERROR 3024 (HY000): Query execution was interrupted, maximum statement execution time exceeded
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```sql
mysql> select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ sleep(1);
+----------+
| sleep(1) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.05 sec)
```

The statement `sleep(1)` should not return without error less than 1 second, and the hint does not return error expectedly.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

```
Release Version: v7.4.0-alpha
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 522a00840385dfa43509a3af2bc79e6ff50252a8
Git Branch: heads/refs/tags/v7.4.0-alpha
UTC Build Time: 2023-08-03 14:26:07
GoVersion: go1.20.7
Race Enabled: false
Check Table Before Drop: false
Store: tikv
```
comments:
https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/miscellaneous-functions.html#function_sleep

```
MySQL 8.0

mysql> SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000);
+-------------+
| SLEEP(1000) |
+-------------+
|           1 |
+-------------+

mysql> SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000), a from t;
ERROR 3024 (HY000): Query execution was interrupted, maximum statement execution time exceeded

TiDB

mysql> SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000);
+-------------+
| SLEEP(1000) |
+-------------+
|           1 |
+-------------+
1 row in set (0.09 sec)

mysql> SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000), a from t;
+-------------+------+
| SLEEP(1000) | a    |
+-------------+------+
|           1 |    1 |
|           1 |    2 |
|           1 |    3 |
+-------------+------+
3 rows in set (0.10 sec)

```

It seems query "SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000);" is compatible with mysql. But "SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1) */ SLEEP(1000), a from t;" is not.

Similar results when query killed by "kill query conn_id".

/cc @you06
